{
  "title": "Visible handwashing and exit flow",
  "reference": {
    "title": "Visible handwashing and exit flow",
    "scope": "Reference for the visible actions in the bundled video, not a complete hygiene procedure. Hidden towel release and actual door opening are not required.",
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "soap",
        "label": "Dispense soap",
        "criterion": "White soap appears on a palm beneath a dispenser; mechanism actuation may be occluded."
      },
      {
        "id": "lather",
        "label": "Rub hands with lather",
        "criterion": "Hands rub with visible foam. Running water is not required."
      },
      {
        "id": "rinse",
        "label": "Rinse under running water",
        "criterion": "A visible flowing water stream contacts the hands. Foam alone is not rinsing."
      },
      {
        "id": "paper",
        "label": "Pull a paper towel",
        "criterion": "A sheet is visibly pulled out of a wall dispenser slot. Holding paper nearby is not enough."
      },
      {
        "id": "dry",
        "label": "Dry hands with the towel",
        "criterion": "Paper contacts the hands as they rub or fold it between them; continued pulling from the slot is different."
      },
      {
        "id": "door",
        "label": "Hold door handle through a towel",
        "criterion": "The hand grips a visible door lever through paper. Actual door opening is not required."
      },
      {
        "id": "bin",
        "label": "Lower towel into bin",
        "criterion": "The hand moves paper below the rim of a lined bin. Visible release is not required."
      }
    ]
  },
  "steps": [

      "step_id": "door",

      "evidence_seconds": [
        21.0,

        22.903

      "uncertainty": "A clearer sample between the scene cut and the bin action is needed. Do not infer grip from the reference label or earlier reviews.",

    },
    {
      "step_id": "bin",
      "status": "observed",

      "evidence_seconds": [
        22.5,
        22.903

      "uncertainty": "The exact release of the paper is not visible and is not required by this reference.",
